authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.note: The specification assigns the xdictionary a hard-owner role. This change admits the independently observed soft-pointer spelling only for a zero-length null DIMSTYLE xdictionary.

implementation: Both typed DIMSTYLE parsing and its later raw-object-shell common-link pass accept role 4 only when size, 32-bit reference and 64-bit reference are zero. Other roles and non-null soft pointers remain refused; no other object type receives this exception.

checks: LibreDWG 0.14 independently identifies owner (4.1.A), xdictionary (4.0.0), following xref (5.0.0) and DIMTXSTY (5.0.0) on the generated R2004/R2010/R2013/R2018 witnesses.

Generated DIMSTYLE controls include AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032: accept the zero-length null, reject a one-byte soft-pointer and a wrong role, check following fields, and retry after refusal. AC1021 is a generated codec control; no R2007 producer witness was qualified.
The independent common shell retains strict soft-pointer-null refusal for generated LAYER controls in AC1021 through AC1032.
With current libdxfrw linked, LibreCAD imported locally generated bundled-codec ownerless DWGs and passed 130 ownerless preservation/refusal/retry/readback assertions over five versions.

limits: This read compatibility observation does not prove general DIMSTYLE write parity, independent producer semantics, native GUI behavior or whole-file support.
All DWG inputs were generated locally from scratch and remain outside the repository.

currentRecheck.result: Both generated fast CTests pass on macOS ARM64, including DIMSTYLE null-soft-pointer acceptance, wrong role and non-null width refusal, reset and corrected retry, and continued LAYER rejection.
currentRecheck.limits: This is a generated parser-vector recheck on the current implementation. The selected cross-codec ownerless replay is separately recorded; producer coverage, native GUI and final frozen inputs remain open.
